summary: xAI announced that Grok and X Premium subscribers can now use Grok models, including grok-build-0.1, inside the Warp terminal-based development environment.

practices.reason: Adds a new way to access Grok models via an existing subscription inside a third-party IDE, a minor integration change for teams already using Warp.
practices.quote: You can now use your Grok or X Premium subscription inside Warp , an agentic development environment built on the terminal and used by almost one million developers.
